onepiece.note: The 'One Piece' anime adaptation is ongoing. As of July 6, 2026, the latest main series episode aired was Episode 1168 on June 28, 2026 (Crunchyroll). The anime is currently in the Elbaf Arc. Based on the anime adapting up to manga chapter 1134 as of April 3, 2026, and the anime's goal of a roughly 1:1 episode-to-chapter adaptation, Episode 1168 is estimated to correspond to manga chapter 1147. To pick up where the anime left off, it is safe to resume reading from manga chapter 1148. [Chapter mapping estimated via web search. Verify before reading to avoid spoilers.]

cowboybepop.note: Cowboy Bebop is an original anime series that aired for 26 episodes (sessions) from 1998 to 1999. Two manga series were later adapted from the anime, telling original or alternate stories, and are not the source material for the anime. [Chapter mapping estimated via web search. omniscientreader.note: An anime adaptation of 'Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint' was officially announced at Anime Expo 2024, with Crunchyroll and Aniplex involved in its production. However, as of July 06, 2026, no episodes have aired, as the anime is reportedly scheduled for release in 2027. Therefore, there is no anime content to track as ongoing or finished, and readers should start from Chapter 1 of the manga/webtoon. [Chapter mapping estimated via web search. oshinoko.note: The 'Oshi no Ko' anime has completed three seasons, with a total of 35 episodes aired. Season 3 concluded on March 25, 2026, adapting up to manga chapter 127. A fourth and final season has been announced and is currently in production. The manga series concluded on November 14, 2024, with 166 chapters. [Chapter mapping estimated via web search.
